researched.name: Hy-Tech Engineers Ltd
researched.trigger: Q1 FY27 results with press release and investor presentation, filed 21-Sep-2026
researched.reason: Revenue Rs 43.0 cr (+13% YoY), EBITDA Rs 8.4 cr (+3%, margin 19.6% vs 21.5%), PAT Rs 4.6 cr (+11%). Growth is steady but not the step-change this style looks for, margins compressed on raw-material costs, and at a Rs 675 cr market cap the annualised Q1 PAT implies roughly 37x earnings. Listed only this month. The stated capacity expansion (about 6.5 acres near Shirwal, Satara) is still a proposal subject to approvals.
